name: @argszero/dsh-overflow-recovery
description: A session whose request exceeds the model's context window and whose summarizer cannot fit that same window has no way out: every later message replays the same oversized history into the same 400, so the session is unusable until someone edits the persisted log by hand. The shipped non-LLM reducer (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner`) reaches only the middle of tool-result text, which is not where a long conversation's weight sits, so there is no fallback for the case where summarization is itself what cannot fit. This plugin is that fallback: it joins `agent/request-error`, calls `next()` FIRST so a summarizer, a provider retry or another plugin always decides before it, and only when nothing claimed the retry does it drop the oldest droppable region of the model-visible surface — one `compaction/prune` shadow price followed by one `user/message` replacement, the same pair the shipped producers append — and returns `{ kind: 'retry' }`. The log keeps every dropped event; only the surface changes. The cut never touches surface node 0 (the system head) and never splits a tool-call/tool-result pair, so it cannot mint the orphan tool call that wedges a session permanently. Inert whenever anything else owns the overflow. Zero runtime dependencies.
